prompt.composition: Widescreen cinematic tableau. Groups organized into 'visual islands'. Left: Hadrosaur family (Edmontosaurus, Anatotitan). Center: Ceratopsian duo (Triceratops, Torosaurus) in a sturdy pose. Right: Ankylosaurus in mid-walk. Background: T-Rex head and torso emerging from high canopy. Foreground: Small, feathered Dakotaraptor darting through ferns.
prompt.lighting: Cinematic 'Magic Hour' with brilliant god-rays filtering through tropical leaves. Strong golden rim-lighting on every character silhouette.
prompt.texture_standard: High-end 3D character groom. Satin-matte skin, velvety feathers, and polished ivory horns. Zero grit, zero scales, zero realistic skin-folds.

color_palette.ceratopsians: Saturated teal and slate-blue with orange 'painted' decorative frill patterns.
color_palette.ankylosaurus: Deep bronze armor with bright ivory spikes.
color_palette.t_rex: Forest-green body, subtle dark stripes, glowing amber eyes.

prompt.environment: Lush tropical jungle clearing with flowering magnolias and oversized fan palms. Clean, painterly mossy ground.
prompt.negative_prompt: photorealistic, grainy, lumpy, grit, scary, horror, blood, open mouths, aggressive, 90s CGI, plastic toy, museum model, grey sky, muddy
